buildSentences.display: The students participated in the science fair to showcase their projects.
The team decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
The professor asked the students to submit their assignments on time.
Many people believe that technology has changed communication significantly.
To prepare for the upcoming presentation the students worked late into the night.
The research study revealed new insights into climate change effects.
Participants were encouraged to share their thoughts during the discussion.
After the conference many attendees networked to discuss collaborative opportunities.

寄信給宿舍辦公室，詢問房間分配的事宜。
寄信給圖書館，要求延長借書期限。
寄信給社團主席，表達希望參加即將舉行的活動。
寄信給客服，反映最近購買的商品有缺陷。
寄信給學校的輔導員，尋求學業上的建議。
discussionPrompts: 教授問：「在當今社會中，科技對人際關係的影響是正面還是負面？」
教授問：「文化多樣性是否有助於社會的進步？」
教授問：「氣候變遷的主要原因是什麼，應該如何應對？」
教授問：「教育應該更多地關注知識還是技能的培養？」
教授問：「社交媒體對青少年的心理健康有何影響？」
教授問：「全球化對本地文化的影響是什麼？」
